bounded_host_request.command:

p=json.load(open("operations/github-project-bounded-host.json"))["dev_job"]["registered_repositories"]
for repo,entry in p.items():
 root=entry["root"]
 def git(*args):
  x=subprocess.run(["git","-C",root,*args],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=6)
  return x.stdout.strip() if x.returncode==0 else "UNKNOWN"
 print(repo,"REGISTERED="+entry["branch"],"ACTUAL="+git("branch","--show-current"),"HEAD="+git("rev-parse","--short","HEAD"),"MAIN="+git("rev-parse","--short","main"),"COMPOSE="+",".join(x.name for x in pathlib.Path(root).glob("*compose*.y*ml")))
'
